items.court_name: Court of Arbitration of Moscow Region
items.text:
Communication No.

A49-61750/2021

Court of Arbitration of Moscow Region

2024-03-09

Demo Perso was involved as a third party. Demo Person presented explanations, pointed out the affiliation of the parties and declared independent claims regarding the subject of the dispute.

As a result of the proceedings, the Court found the following circumstances. 
The case file contains documents supporting the facts as set out in the statement of claim.
Reference (control): Demo P. Demo P..
For full-text search: party/participant/contractor/memorandum.
The Court considers it necessary to satisfy the plaintiff ' s claims.

DECIDED:
Retrieve the defendant in favour of the plaintiff 685989 roubles.

Communication No.

A45-82226/2024

Court of Arbitration of Moscow

2024-08-27

The Court considered the case of the Demo Perso claim for the recovery of contractual debts. Demo Perso did not accept the claim, indicated lack of delivery, and stated the credit. In the text of the Demo Perso Act, reference is made repeatedly.

As a result of the proceedings, the Court found the following circumstances. 
The case file contains documents supporting the facts as set out in the statement of claim.
References (control): Demo Perso Demo P. Demo Person Demo Person Demo Person Demo Perso.
For full-text search: party/participant/contractor/memorandum.
The Court considers it necessary to satisfy the plaintiff ' s claims.

DECIDED:
Retrieve the defendant in favour of the plaintiff 1217151 roubles.
